statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch 2> /dev/null | sed -e '/^[^*]/d' -e 's/* \(.*\)/ (\1)/'); printf "\033[01;28m%s\033[00;32m%s\033[0m" "$cwd" "$branch"
